text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top: each of the seven pieces of the G-all+D1 mean forecast. Bottom: the pieces' sum against observed net power, in points of effective capacity (negative is export), for the same weeks as the raw-weeks figure. Gaps are half-hours with no reading.'
text.tspan: Top: each of the seven pieces of the G-all+D1 mean forecast. Bottom: the pieces' sum against
observed net power, in points of effective capacity (negative is export), for the same weeks as
the raw-weeks figure. Gaps are half-hours with no reading.
